title: Queue headroom and overload reporting (review findings on PRs 4 and 5)
why_risk: changes the capacity of the engine's event queue, which changes what an overloaded pattern emits; adds a public constant and a field to Played
spec_rev: SPEC-0001 product r1, tech r1 (tech.md already says the queue holds 1,024 events)
evidence: finding 4: on QUEUE_CAP 512 a strummed 6-note chord on every step at 240 BPM reached 410 to 430 of 512 slots and the dense stress scene refused 230,708 notes in 10 s. invariants::a_heavy_chord_pattern_leaves_the_event_queue_at_most_half_full FAILED at 512 ('the queue reached 410 of 512 slots') and passes at 1,024 (handoffs/evidence/pr6-queue-headroom-red-run.txt)

the dense scene still overflows at 1,024 (187,409 refused in 10 s). That is the overload scene: invariants::overload_is_counted_and_refuses_whole_notes_never_half asserts it is counted, that every NoteOn still has its NoteOff, and that nothing is late

invariants::event_times_do_not_depend_on_the_hosts_buffer_size now also asserts 0 refused, 0 deferred and 0 late events for every buffer size; two new tests cover a host that changes its size on every call (32, 480, 64, 1024, 7, 4096, 100, 1, 512) and a one-sample host. Both passed on the parent engine, so they close the review's coverage gap and found no bug

Engine is 47,552 B (was 27,072 B). 0 allocations in 30 s of dense render at 1,024 (counting allocator). Chords scene p99.9 unchanged within noise; worst dense-scene p99.9 120.8 us is 9.1% of the 64-sample budget (handoffs/evidence/pr6-queue-capacity-measurements.txt)
the audit's 'p50 8.9 -> 2.8 us' claim in the WENGE-0010 implementation record is withdrawn by the correction record there

fixture: `play N step` with a count that overflows u32 panicked in a debug build; it is now an error, and a count above 100,000 steps is refused (fixture::tests::a_play_count_that_overflows_is_an_error_not_a_panic_or_a_wrap, handoffs/evidence/pr6-play-step-red-run.txt)

octorun prints a warning on stderr for refused, deferred and late events, and a golden test asserts none of the five example patterns has any (cli::a_pattern_that_overloads_the_engine_says_so_on_stderr_and_a_clean_one_does_not FAILED with the warning removed, handoffs/evidence/pr6-octorun-warning-red-run.txt)
cargo test --workspace passes; just wasm-smoke: 3 patterns identical to the native golden

review nit 11: octoffi::tests::the_header_lists_the_event_tags_and_diagnostic_fields_in_the_rust_order reads octoffi.h; swapping two event tags in the header fails it (handoffs/evidence/pr6-header-mutation.txt)

review nits 12 and 16: the golden.rs comment now says what the determinism gate checks; Diagnostics::deferred_events documents that it counts per chunk; the constant-tempo lookahead is recorded in AMBIGUITIES.md
unresolved: The 256-events-per-call cap still binds above about 4,096 samples on dense patterns; events wait, none are lost
A real host can reach the overload the dense scene shows. What the sequencer should do then (refuse, thin, or warn the player) is a product decision for @beaudesign
The lookahead assumes a constant tempo (recorded in AMBIGUITIES.md, not fixed)
